structured.answer: It seems worth having: my employer adds up to 7.5% of my salary and I put in 2.5%, and after 6 years from the first payment I can take it all out without tax (3 years if I've reached retirement age). But I didn't understand what the money is invested in, so I'd ask the bank which option is the safe one, and about the fee of up to 2% a year.
